name: Coursera Scraper
description: Coursera scraper for Python and the command line: course search by keyword with partner, rating, exact review count, level, duration, skills and product type (course, specialization, certificate, degree), as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: search
commands.help: Coursera search results for a topic
commands.description: Search Coursera by keyword — partner, rating, review count, level and duration per course.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: What to search Coursera for — a topic, technology or skill.

inputs.name: level
inputs.description: Restrict to one difficulty level. Coursera's own filter values.

inputs.name: product_type
inputs.description: Restrict to one kind of product. Coursera's own filter values — use "Courses" to exclude degrees and certificates.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to search from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (default us).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many results to deliver at most (1–60). You pay only for delivered results.
